name: exiftool
title: ExifTool
description: Reads the metadata of images, videos, audio, PDFs, Office documents and many other formats with ExifTool 13.25 (EXIF, IPTC, XMP, GPS, maker notes, ...), all tags or a chosen subset with wildcards. Files are read from the folder mounted at /work. Read-only: this build offers no writing or removing of metadata. No network.
license: MIT (MCP server, joshmsimpson/exiftool_mcp, patched) AND Artistic-1.0 OR GPL-1.0-or-later (ExifTool, Debian package)

mounts.description: The folder with the files to inspect (read-only is enough)

notes: Patched: requested tag names filter ExifTool's JSON in Python instead of becoming ExifTool options (upstream let a tag such as "if" run Perl code); the write and remove tools are removed.
